description: Admin screens for Solhigson apps as Razor components, rendered on the server. An app owns its routes; the package ships no page.
releaseNotes: 10.1.0: the settings screen, the package's first screen (Solhigson.Admin.Components, Solhigson.Admin.Settings, Solhigson.Admin.Auditing). KitSettingsEditor, which an app places on a page of its own with its route and [Permission], lists every setting the app's catalogue declares, one section a group in the order the catalogue registered them, under a Settings header that counts them and links to a needs-attention view, with a GET filter over key, name and purpose, never a value. CanEdit, false unless set, comes from a second permission: without it no form renders, a post is the framework's 400 and a Personal value shows as Hidden; a Secret's value is never written into the page. With it each line is a form of its own that saves or resets that setting through Core's SaveDeclaredSettingAsync and ResetDeclaredSettingAsync and says the outcome at the line: saved, reset, no change, a refusal beside the field in the screen's words with what was typed kept (never a secret's), changed since the page loaded, failed with no exception text, and a Warn alert when other instances were not told and may show the old value until their settings cache recovers. Under the groups, Rows with no declaration lists each stored row no declared setting matches, by name and flag pills, never a value; with CanEdit each has a Remove that opens one KitConfirm saying older code may still read the row by name and the screen cannot put it back, and its confirm calls RemoveUndeclaredRowAsync. Above the groups a warning says a secret's save is refused while the legacy encryptor is in force. The setting field: KitSettingField renders one KitSetting (KitSetting.From(DeclaredSettingLine)) with one control of its kind: a Switch a toggle that submits its form when it changes (a Save in noscript otherwise), a number with min, max and step, a Duration an amount and a unit or one text field, a List a textarea, a Text a text field; a Secret, a row stored sensitive and a masked line an empty password field, with no value or mask in the markup; with ReadOnly, Fields, Error and ChildContent. KitSettingValue.Compose turns the posted KitSettingFields into the setting's stored text or a refusal sentence (KitSettingComposed), never an exception, and Fill gives each control's starting values. The audit seam: IKitAudit (Records, and RecordAsync answering whether a row was written), which AddSolhigsonAdmin registers scoped as KitAudit<TContext>, resolving the audit service, the actor provider and the context from the request at first use; KitAuditEvent and KitAuditActions. Each save, reset and removal done is recorded as a SecurityEvent on AppSetting, settings.saved, settings.reset or settings.stray-removed, with the actor and a payload of the key and the values before and after as the framework's result shows them, the mask for a Secret, a row stored sensitive and a Personal value. A removed stray row stored plain under a plain name keeps its raw value in the append-only audit row: only a row stored sensitive or under a secret-looking name is masked. When Records is false (no audit service resolves, or the context maps no AuditTrail and no IAuditSink is registered) the screen says changes here leave no audit record and one Warning is logged a process; a record that fails logs one Error and says so at the line, and the change is not undone. TContext must be registered scoped. KitConfirm gains OnConfirm and KitDialog OnSubmit, so a confirm's form is handled by the component that owns it; kit.forms.js submits the form of a data-kit-submit-on-change control and keeps one such post in flight a page; the gallery gains a settings section; kit.manifest.json gains the kit-setting and kit-settings names. The README documents the app's page and every log line the screen, the seam and a save write. Minor bump: every type and member is new, and no existing component's behaviour changes. Depends on Solhigson.Framework.Core 10.27.0 or later. 10.0.0: the first release of Solhigson.Admin, the admin kit: Razor components for Solhigson apps, rendered statically on the server, with no interactive render mode and no inline script; an app owns every route, and the package holds components and no screen yet. Head and theme: KitHead, first in <head>, links the kit's stylesheet and scripts with the page's nonce where its policy uses one; KitTheme reads the viewer's light or dark choice from its cookie on the server, with KitTheme.HtmlAttributes(HttpContext) for <html>, and KitThemeSwitch offers the choice. Components: KitButton, KitStatusPill and KitAlert; KitField, one field for every input kind; KitDialog (a modal or a drawer) and KitConfirm on the native <dialog>; KitMenu, KitMenuItem and KitMenuForm, a row menu on the native popover; KitShell, the admin layout with a skip link, a side rail, a top bar with the user's menu (the theme choices and sign-out) and the main region; KitPageHeader, KitLead, KitEmptyState and KitPager; KitTable with KitColumn, and KitFilterBar, Get or Post; KitMark; and KitGallery, every component in every state on fixed example data, for a page an app adds in development or behind a permission. Links: every url a kit component takes goes through KitHref: a ~/ path is joined to the path base; a button's or a link menu item's Href may also be an https:// address (KitHref.LocalOrHttps), and a form's action is local alone (KitHref.Local). Menu: IKitMenuSource builds the shell's menu from the permissions the signed-in user's roles hold, read through PermissionManager's cached reads, and AddSolhigsonAdmin<TUser, TContext>() or AddSolhigsonAdmin<TUser, TKey, TContext>() registers it; the menu shows, each page's [Permission] enforces. Styles: tokens for every colour, size, space, radius, shadow, duration, curve and font, light and dark, in layers (kit.tokens, kit.base, kit.components) that an app's app layer overrides, each name listed in kit.manifest.json, a name leaving which is a breaking change; every motion reads a duration token that is 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion. Rules: the package's tests hold its markup, scripts and stylesheets to no inline script, style or handler, no other host, every href and form action through KitHref, measured contrast pairs, and no colour, length or duration outside the tokens. Depends on Solhigson.Framework.Core 10.24.0 or later.
